recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed unless a future generated-output/link check finds that the diagram renderer stops linking to these existing targets.
issue_request: FHIR-15958 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 technical correction asking that datatypes.html provide distinct anchors for url, canonical, and uuid rather than incorrectly using the uri anchor for multiple primitive datatype rows.
initial_application: The Jira comments say the issue was already done. The same historical correction is visible in git commit 07b20b4fc8 / SVN revision 14154, which changed source/datatypes.html so url and canonical no longer shared the uri anchor and added the uuid row/anchor.
additional_context: FHIR-16548 is the same change family and specifically reported the canonical member of the missing-anchor set. Current source/datatypes.html is build-relevant and contains anchors for all three requested primitive datatypes. No Zulip or Confluence search result was found that changes this conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because source/datatypes.html already defines the url, canonical, and uuid named anchors requested by FHIR-15958.

related_jiras.note: The seed identified the canonical member of the same missing-anchor set and cites FHIR-15958 as the same problem.
